copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装好后,当用户要求用大白话解释某个技术概念时,Claude 会把内容按「谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时」五个方面拆开来讲,而不是直接甩术语。
howto.when: 当用户想搞清楚某个技术内容的来龙去脉,说出「用大白话解释一下」或类似“explain to me the who, what, where, why, and when of this”的请求时触发。

say.text: 用大白话解释一下区块链的 who、what、where、why、when。
say.note: Claude 会按五个方面拆解。

say.text: 这段话太专业了,帮我按 who/what/where/why/when 讲讲。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for a plain-English breakdown of a technical topic, Claude structures the answer around the who, what, where, why, and when of that topic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants a plain-English explanation of something technical — for example, by saying "explain to me the who, what, where, why, and when of this".

say_en.text: Explain blockchain in plain English: who, what, where, why, when.
say_en.note: Claude breaks it down into five parts.

say_en.text: This is too technical. Walk me through the who/what/where/why/when.
